datasets.name: Himalayan Landslide Detection Dataset
datasets.citation: Ghimire, P. et al. (2024). Himalayan Landslide Detection Dataset (HLAD). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22811448
datasets.suitability_limitations: Blank license on Zenodo legally precludes downloading or redistribution without explicit permission. Annotations are bounding boxes and scar masks rather than categorical geotechnical hazard severity and lack ground-level road/infrastructure context.

datasets.name: Landslide4Sense Multispectral Satellite Benchmark
datasets.citation: Ghorbanzadeh, O. et al. (2022). Landslide4Sense: Reference Benchmark Data and Deep Learning Models for Landslide Detection. IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Magazine.
datasets.suitability_limitations: Incompatible 14-band remote sensing modality (Sentinel-2, ALOS DEM). Binary pixel masks are for spatial segmentation, not geotechnical triage. Belongs to macro-scale satellite GIS pipeline, not conversational RGB vision model.

datasets.name: PahaarPulse Ground Field Report Benchmark
datasets.citation: PahaarPulse Geotechnical AI Research Group (2026). Ground-Level Field Photograph Hazard Screening Benchmark Protocol. PahaarPulse Specification.
datasets.geographic_coverage: Indian Himalayan Region (Uttarakhand, Sikkim, Himachal Pradesh)
datasets.suitability_limitations: Target architecture schema. Requires independent dual-expert geotechnical adjudication prior to computing benchmark scorecards.
